text:
maria.docs: quick sync — i opened PR #4327 for the offline-installer checklist. noticed the egress section and the Node SDK examples are ambiguous for sealed sites. can someone sanity check?

dan.w: taking a look now. i think the egress bit that says 'allow outbound 443' needs to call out SNI passthrough for customers using proxy SNATs. small wording change. :eyes:

kevin-r: also the SDK snippet still uses the old `OfflineClient.importBundle()` signature. we changed that in v1.4 — should show the async/stream pattern.

jenna: can you paste the current snippet? i'll update while i'm in the PR.

maria.docs: current snippet in the PR:
```js
const client = new OfflineClient({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN });
client.importBundle('/tmp/bundle.tar.gz');
```

kevin-r: replace with:
```js
const client = new OfflineClient({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN });
for await (const chunk of client.importBundleStream('/tmp/bundle.tar.gz')) {
  // progress UI or logging
}
await client.finalizeImport();
```

jenna: ok i'll swap that in and add a note about retry semantics for partial uploads.

dan.w: for the egress text i suggest: "If you're behind a NATed proxy, ensure SNI passthrough to destination hosts is preserved and outbound TLS to *.redwood.ai:443 is allowed; adding SNAT rules that rewrite SNI may break installer downloads." short and actionable.

maria.docs: perfect. one more: KMS/HSM section mentions `/usr/lib/pkcs11/libhsm.so` as an example path. we should add a callout that on some distros the path is `/opt/hsm/pkcs11.so` and link to the HSM vendor docs.

kevin-r: +1. also add small snippet for verifying PKCS#11 module: `pkcs11-tool --module /path/to/module -L`

lint-bot: docs/linted: PR #4327 — 3 markdown link issues, 1 code-fence lang missing.

maria.docs: thanks @lint-bot — fixing links now. i'll also add a tiny checklist at the top: preflight network tests, pkcs11 verification, sdk import sample, and link to migration notes.

jenna: once updated tag me and i'll merge during my doc hour. :shipit:

maria.docs: tagging when ready. thanks everyone!
